source_policy: Reviewed public official plan page and installed SDK contract plus retained research report; no authenticated/account/provider execution calls.

sources.facts: Covered subscription work does not debit Spark/SOGNI. Published table includes H3 and H3 Turbo on both tiers. Same-account API keys inherit covered entitlement. Admission/fair-use and terms remain server-controlled and mutable.

sources.fact: Explicit subscription requires coverage and fails if unavailable; auto may fall back to tokens.
SDK5.49 has account subscription status, no inspected read-only account+model entitlement preflight; token estimator is render value rather than proof of subscription debit.

decision: Yes: an evidence-backed zero incremental per-job liability quote is defensible for a narrowly covered subscription request. It is an application interpretation of published billing policy plus server-enforced mode, not a guaranteed entitlement/admission/zero-total-project-cost assertion. Never use token/render-value estimator as the subscription job debit.
required_quote_evidence: Fresh authenticated stable account identity and active paid subscription status from the SAME credential/connection binding used to submit; do not authorize from active flag alone, account display name or configured key. Initially exclude trial/grace/ambiguous states unless separately researched and approved.

Pinned reviewed published coverage snapshot: source URL, capture/hash, provider policy version or app review version, capturedAt/expiresAt. Explicit finite TTL (local conservative policy, e.g.24h) and revalidation on provider terms/errors; do not call TTL a vendor guarantee.

Versioned explicit registry exact model ID -> documented H3/H3Turbo family/workflow and allowed operation/configuration. Require current live capability evidence for that exact ID. No prefix/fuzzy-name matching, unknown or excluded add-on/workflow support, or extrapolation to text/audio/image models.

Exact immutable request forces billingMode=subscription end to end; SDK transport must not emit auto/tokens or retry into another mode/model. Pin account evidence, quote, coverage registry version and credential binding before atomic reservation+submitting.
Standing human authorization permits subscription mode, exact model/operation and explicit project/account cap scope. I01 atomic ledger boundary independently accepted before any real job.

BudgetQuote_encoding.operation: exact covered media operation (initial H3 take only)
BudgetQuote_encoding.liabilityMeaning: Incremental provider job debit under enforced subscription mode; excludes already-paid/renewing subscription period payment. USD0 is zero money projection, not Spark/SOGNI conversion. User budget view must state this scope.
BudgetQuote_encoding.expiresAt: minimum of account evidence/status TTL, reviewed coverage TTL, live quote-policy evidence expiry and any observed subscription-period limit. Recheck current clock/bindings at submission boundary.
BudgetQuote_encoding.unknown_rule: Any required fact missing/stale/mismatched -> retain unknown quote or block binding/reserve. No presumptive subscription zero.

persistent_provenance: Keep B1 schemas unchanged if AccountEvidence source/reference and QuoteAccountBinding evidence IDs can resolve an immutable trusted attestation bundle containing account/status response hashes, exact-model registry mapping and coverage policy snapshot/version/TTL. Do not place those opaque references only in transient logs. If existing B1 fields cannot durably resolve the bundle, request one narrow provenance extension from integrator before composer work; never invent a second ledger.
settlement: Zero estimate still produces durable reservation and unsettled accounting state; unresolved amount may be0, but acceptance/billing facts remain unknown. Media completion alone does not turn it into final actual0.

Final actual0 requires a trusted exact-job/account completed billing record affirming subscription mode/no incremental debit. Render-value/costActual USD can represent usage valuation; do not treat it as charged amount unless semantics prove charge. Absence from transaction history is not evidence.
If exact trusted billing mode/zero settlement record cannot be obtained, leave reservation unsettled/actual unknown and show that fact. Do not invent final zero merely from quote or success.

If trusted actual charge contradicts expected coverage, persist nonzero actual/overrun and evidence conflict, suspend further subscription-zero quotes for affected account/model/policy and surface operator action. Never drop charge to preserve quote0.
admission_and_recovery: NOT_ENTITLED,QUEUE_CAP,GRACE_RETRY or unknown admission may visibly reject/block; no automatic mode/model fallback. Affirmative preacceptance/nonbilling proof may release reservation once; ambiguous timeout keeps submitting/unknown and must reconcile exact request before any new submit. This addendum does not assert an account-model preflight endpoint exists.
language: Use expected incremental job charge:0 under verified subscription coverage; admission and actual billing remain provider-authoritative. Avoid free, guaranteed eligible, unlimited throughput or zero total production cost.
verification_before_real_use: Fake same-account active+exact H3 coverage+live catalog+enforced mode succeeds with0 quote and durable reservation.
Changed credential/account, stale policy/status, unlisted exact ID, trial/grace, missing provenance or mode auto/tokens blocks.

Queue/entitlement rejection zero resubmit; ambiguous acceptance reservation retained; media completion without exact billing evidence remains unknown; trusted subscription billing settles0; contradiction stores actual overrun.
